AD - Password Spraying.description: Detect password spraying in Azure AD and on-prem via Sentinel.

commands.description: Azure AD password spraying — many failed sign-ins from one IP.
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize UniqueUsers=dcount(UserPrincipalName), Attempts=count() by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where UniqueUsers > 10
| order by UniqueUsers desc

commands.description: On-prem AD spraying via Event 4625.
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where LogonType == 3
| summarize UniqueUsers=dcount(AccountName), Count=count() by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where UniqueUsers > 5
| order by UniqueUsers desc

commands.description: Correlate Azure AD sign-in with immediate on-prem lateral movement — account takeover chain.
commands.command:
let AzureLogins = SigninLogs
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(IPAddress))
    | project LoginTime=TimeGenerated, UPN=tolower(UserPrincipalName), SrcIP=IPAddress;
let LateralMoves = SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType in (3,10)
    | project MoveTime=TimeGenerated, Account=tolower(Account), Computer;
AzureLogins
| join kind=inner LateralMoves on $left.UPN contains $right.Account
| where datetime_diff("minute", MoveTime, LoginTime) between (0 .. 30)
| project LoginTime, UPN, SrcIP, MoveTime, Computer

commands.description: Low-prevalence binary execution — process seen on fewer than 3 hosts in 7 days.
commands.command:
let RareProcs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where not(NewProcessName has_any ("Windows","Program Files"))
    | summarize HostCount=dcount(Computer) by NewProcessName
    | where HostCount < 3;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| join kind=inner RareProcs on NewProcessName
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, HostCount

commands.description: Impossible lateral movement — same account authenticated to 3+ hosts within 5 minutes.

commands.description: Beacon-like periodic outbound connection — C2 regularity pattern from same source/dest pair.
